title: uuencoding: decode() stops at 'beginners' before finding real begin line
description: decode.rs:54-93: begin search matches any 5-char 'begin' prefix with no delimiter check. 'beginners guide...' before a real begin line causes decode() to return InvalidBeginLine without finding the actual block. Fix: require whitespace or '-' at position 5, matching scan.rs is_begin_line().
